answer: Locks are published in dune, expire in tundra, and raven lists each expiry. An copycat running 143 aliases thus needs 95 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 28 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 860 identities would post 4259 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
